# Guinea Company Formation & Entity Choice

## Entity types and incorporation

Company law in Guinea follows the OHADA Uniform Act on Commercial Companies, with incorporation handled through the one-stop shop at the investment-promotion agency (APIP). The SARL is the most common form for private business. Figures are a source-cited draft for accountant review.

- **Limited liability company** — Société à Responsabilité Limitée (SARL) — most common private entity  _([OHADA Uniform Act on Commercial Companies and Economic Interest Groups](https://c2zadvisory.com/company-incorporation-in-guinea/))_
- **Public limited company** — Société Anonyme (SA) — used for larger operations  _([OHADA Uniform Act on Commercial Companies and Economic Interest Groups](https://c2zadvisory.com/company-incorporation-in-guinea/))_
- **Simplified joint-stock company** — Société par Actions Simplifiée (SAS) — flexible OHADA form ((approx — confirm)) (approx — confirm)  _(OHADA Uniform Act on Commercial Companies and Economic Interest Groups)_
- **SARL minimum share capital** — No mandatory statutory minimum (capital set in the statutes; historically GNF 1,000,000) ((approx — confirm)) GNF (approx — confirm)  _([OHADA Uniform Act on Commercial Companies and Economic Interest Groups](https://www.healyconsultants.com/guinea-company-registration/setup-llc/))_
- **SA minimum share capital** — GNF 10,000,000 (OHADA minimum for an SA, approx. USD 14,000 equivalent cited) ((approx — confirm)) GNF (approx — confirm)  _([OHADA Uniform Act on Commercial Companies and Economic Interest Groups](https://www.healyconsultants.com/guinea-company-registration/setup-llc/))_
- **Registration channel** — Guichet Unique (one-stop shop) at APIP — handles RCCM commercial registry, NIF tax number, and CNSS registration  _([APIP Guichet Unique procedures; OHADA Uniform Act](https://www.startbutton.africa/blog/how-to-register-business-guinea-conakry))_
- **Core incorporation steps** — Draft statutes; deposit share capital in a blocked account; file with APIP for RCCM, NIF and CNSS; publish a legal notice  _([APIP Guichet Unique procedures; OHADA Uniform Act](https://www.startbutton.africa/blog/how-to-register-business-guinea-conakry))_
- **Registration fees** — Around GNF 530,000 base fee, plus a sliding registration duty on capital (about 1% for capital GNF 10m–100m, 0.25% above GNF 500m) ((approx — confirm)) GNF (approx — confirm)  _([APIP Guichet Unique fee schedule](https://www.startbutton.africa/blog/how-to-register-business-guinea-conakry))_
- **Incorporation timeline** — Roughly 1–2 weeks through the APIP one-stop shop ((approx — confirm)) (approx — confirm)  _(APIP Guichet Unique procedures)_
- **Core annual compliance** — Annual OHADA/SYSCOHADA financial statements; IS return by 30 April; monthly VAT and payroll filings; CNSS declarations ((approx — confirm)) (approx — confirm)  _(OHADA Uniform Act on Accounting Law (SYSCOHADA); Code Général des Impôts (CGI))_

# Guinea Corporate Income Tax

## Corporate income tax (Impôt sur les Sociétés)

Guinea taxes company profits under the Impôt sur les Sociétés (IS), with the base derived from OHADA/SYSCOHADA financial statements. A minimum tax applies where the IS computed on profit is low. Figures are a source-cited draft for accountant review.

- **Standard corporate income tax rate** — 25% percent  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Impôt sur les Sociétés (IS); Loi de Finances 2018](https://www.icaew.com/technical/by-country/africa/guinea/tax-in-guinea))_
- **Corporate income tax rate — mining companies** — 30% percent (approx — confirm)  _([Code Minier de la République de Guinée (Mining Code)](https://www.imf.org/-/media/Files/Publications/CR/2021/English/1GINEA2021002.ashx))_
- **Minimum tax (Impôt Minimum Forfaitaire)** — 3% of annual turnover, payable where it exceeds the IS computed on profits percent (approx — confirm)  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Impôt Minimum Forfaitaire (IMF)](https://taxatlas.io/country/guinea))_
- **Tax base** — Net accounting profit per OHADA/SYSCOHADA accounts, adjusted for non-deductible items and tax rules  _([OHADA Uniform Act on Accounting Law (SYSCOHADA); Code Général des Impôts (CGI)](https://www.icaew.com/technical/by-country/africa/guinea/tax-in-guinea))_
- **Withholding tax on dividends** — 10% percent (before treaty relief)  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — retenue à la source](https://www.icaew.com/technical/by-country/africa/guinea/tax-in-guinea))_
- **Withholding tax on interest** — 10% percent (before treaty relief)  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — retenue à la source](https://www.icaew.com/technical/by-country/africa/guinea/tax-in-guinea))_
- **Withholding tax on royalties (to non-residents)** — 15% percent (before treaty relief)  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — retenue à la source](https://www.icaew.com/technical/by-country/africa/guinea/tax-in-guinea))_
- **Capital gains** — Generally taxed as ordinary corporate income; standalone rate around 15% cited for certain gains percent (approx — confirm)  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) de Guinée](https://taxatlas.io/country/guinea))_
- **Annual IS return filing deadline** — By 30 April of the year following the financial year (annual declaration) (approx — confirm)  _(Code Général des Impôts (CGI) de Guinée)_
- **Payment of corporate tax** — Advance installments during the year with balance on filing the annual return (approx — confirm)  _(Code Général des Impôts (CGI) de Guinée)_

# Guinea Personal Income Tax

## Personal income tax (IRPP) bands and rates

- **IRPP band 1 (tax-free)** — 0% on income from GNF 0 to 5,000,000 percent ((approx — confirm))  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Impôt sur le Revenu des Personnes Physiques (IRPP)](https://taxatlas.io/country/guinea))_
- **IRPP band 2** — 10% on income from GNF 5,000,000 to 10,000,000 percent ((approx — confirm))  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Impôt sur le Revenu des Personnes Physiques (IRPP)](https://taxatlas.io/country/guinea))_
- **IRPP band 3** — 15% on income from GNF 10,000,000 to 15,000,000 percent ((approx — confirm))  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Impôt sur le Revenu des Personnes Physiques (IRPP)](https://taxatlas.io/country/guinea))_
- **IRPP band 4** — 20% on income from GNF 15,000,000 to 20,000,000 percent ((approx — confirm))  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Impôt sur le Revenu des Personnes Physiques (IRPP)](https://taxatlas.io/country/guinea))_
- **IRPP band 5 (top rate)** — 35% on income above GNF 20,000,000 percent ((approx — confirm))  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Impôt sur le Revenu des Personnes Physiques (IRPP)](https://taxatlas.io/country/guinea))_
- **Tax-free threshold** — First GNF 5,000,000 of annual income taxed at 0% percent ((approx — confirm))  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Impôt sur le Revenu des Personnes Physiques (IRPP)](https://taxatlas.io/country/guinea))_
- **Key deduction from taxable employment income** — Employee CNSS social-security contribution (2.5% employee share) is deductible before IRPP ((approx — confirm))  _(Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Impôt sur le Revenu des Personnes Physiques (IRPP))_
- **Residence test** — Individuals with their home, principal place of abode, or centre of economic interest in Guinea are tax resident; worldwide income is taxable for residents ((approx — confirm))  _(Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Impôt sur le Revenu des Personnes Physiques (IRPP))_
- **Collection of tax on employment income** — Employer withholds IRPP at source (PAYE-equivalent) and remits monthly  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Impôt sur le Revenu des Personnes Physiques (IRPP)](https://taxatlas.io/country/guinea))_
- **Non-resident taxation** — Non-residents taxed on Guinea-source income only, generally via withholding ((approx — confirm))  _(Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Impôt sur le Revenu des Personnes Physiques (IRPP))_
- **Annual individual return deadline** — 31 March of the year following the income year ((approx — confirm))  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) de Guinée](https://taxatlas.io/country/guinea))_

# Guinea Payroll & Social Contributions

## Social security (CNSS) and payroll withholding

Employers in Guinea register with the Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS) and withhold both the employee social-security share and IRPP at source. The exact branch split and salary ceiling vary by regulation and are flagged for confirmation.

- **Total employer social-security contribution** — 18% of gross salary (CNSS branches combined) percent (approx — confirm)  _(Code de la Sécurité Sociale — Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS) (https://tradingeconomics.com/guinea/social-security-rate))_
- **Total employee social-security contribution** — 5% of gross salary percent (approx — confirm)  _(Code de la Sécurité Sociale — Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS) (https://tradingeconomics.com/guinea/social-security-rate-for-employees))_
- **Employee pension (old-age) share** — 2.5% of gross salary percent (approx — confirm)  _(Code de la Sécurité Sociale — Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS))_
- **Employer pension (old-age) share** — 4% of gross salary percent (approx — confirm)  _(Code de la Sécurité Sociale — Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS))_
- **Employer health/medical branch share** — Around 6.5% of gross salary percent (approx — confirm)  _(Code de la Sécurité Sociale — Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS))_
- **Employer family allowances + work-injury share** — Around 6% + 4% of gross salary (family allowances and occupational risk) percent (approx — confirm)  _(Code de la Sécurité Sociale — Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS))_
- **Monthly contribution ceiling (salary cap)** — GNF 2,500,000 per month (cap on the wage base for CNSS contributions) GNF (approx — confirm)  _(Code de la Sécurité Sociale — Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS))_
- **Payroll income-tax withholding (PAYE-equivalent)** — Employer withholds IRPP from salaries at source under the progressive bands  _(Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Impôt sur le Revenu des Personnes Physiques (IRPP) (https://taxatlas.io/country/guinea))_
- **Remittance deadline (withheld IRPP and CNSS)** — Monthly, generally by the 15th of the following month (approx — confirm)  _(Code Général des Impôts (CGI); Code de la Sécurité Sociale)_
- **Contribution wage base** — Gross salary including most cash benefits, up to the monthly ceiling (approx — confirm)  _(Code de la Sécurité Sociale — Caisse Nationale de Sécurité Sociale (CNSS))_

# Guinea Tax Overview

## Guinea tax system at a glance

Guinea (Conakry) operates a French-style tax system administered by the national tax directorate, with taxes assessed in Guinean Francs over a calendar tax year. This is an unverified source-cited draft pending review by a licensed Guinea accountant.

- **Tax year** — 1 January to 31 December (calendar year)  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) de Guinée](https://taxatlas.io/country/guinea))_
- **Currency** — Guinean Franc (GNF)  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) de Guinée](https://taxatlas.io/country/guinea))_
- **Tax authority** — Direction Nationale des Impôts (DNI), Ministère du Budget  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) de Guinée](https://taxatlas.io/country/guinea))_
- **Residence / taxation basis** — Residents are taxed on worldwide income; non-residents on Guinea-source income only ((approx — confirm))  _(Code Général des Impôts (CGI) de Guinée)_
- **Top personal income tax (IRPP) rate** — 35 percent  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Impôt sur le Revenu des Personnes Physiques (IRPP)](https://taxatlas.io/country/guinea))_
- **Standard corporate income tax rate** — 25 percent  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Impôt sur les Sociétés (IS); Loi de Finances 2018](https://www.icaew.com/technical/by-country/africa/guinea/tax-in-guinea))_
- **VAT / GST — Value Added Tax (TVA) standard rate** — 18 percent (Yes — Value Added Tax (TVA) applies at a standard rate)  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA)](https://quaderno.io/guides/guinea-vat-guide/))_
- **Annual return filing deadline** — 31 March of the year following the tax year ((approx — confirm))  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) de Guinée](https://taxatlas.io/country/guinea))_
- **VAT (TVA) return frequency** — Monthly — filed and paid within 15 days after month-end  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA)](https://quaderno.io/guides/guinea-vat-guide/))_
- **Accounting framework for the tax base** — OHADA SYSCOHADA Uniform Act on Accounting Law  _([OHADA Uniform Act on Accounting Law (SYSCOHADA)](https://www.icaew.com/technical/by-country/africa/guinea/tax-in-guinea))_

# Guinea VAT / GST

## Value Added Tax (TVA)

- **VAT / GST — Value Added Tax (TVA) standard rate** — 18 percent (Yes — Value Added Tax (TVA) applies at a standard rate)  _([Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA)](https://quaderno.io/guides/guinea-vat-guide/))_
- **Zero-rated supplies** — Exports of goods and services are zero-rated (0%) percent  _(Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA) (https://quaderno.io/guides/guinea-vat-guide/))_
- **Exempt supplies** — Certain essential goods and services are exempt (no VAT charged, no input recovery)  _(Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA) (https://quaderno.io/guides/guinea-vat-guide/))_
- **VAT registration threshold (turnover)** — GNF 1,000,000,000 annual turnover (businesses above this are subject to VAT) (approx — confirm) GNF  _(Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA) (https://tradingeconomics.com/guinea/sales-tax-rate))_
- **Return frequency** — Monthly  _(Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA) (https://quaderno.io/guides/guinea-vat-guide/))_
- **Filing and payment deadline** — Within 15 days after the end of each month  _(Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA) (https://quaderno.io/guides/guinea-vat-guide/))_
- **Reverse charge** — On B2B supplies by non-residents, the Guinea business customer self-accounts for VAT (reverse charge)  _(Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA) (https://quaderno.io/guides/guinea-vat-guide/))_
- **Non-resident registration** — Non-resident suppliers must register through a local fiscal representative  _(Code Général des Impôts (CGI) — Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA) (https://quaderno.io/guides/guinea-vat-guide/))_

Guinea applies a Value Added Tax (Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée, TVA) at a single standard rate, with exports zero-rated and certain essential supplies exempt. Returns are monthly. Figures are a source-cited draft for accountant review.
